status: Final mechanical candidate exact audit passed; grille3mm pitch both axes,1.2mm ligaments; R4.0 bosses and4.3AF M2nut pockets

speaker.source: Conservative rectangular 15x10x3.5 envelope from approximate listing dimensions

cradle_ring.name: SpeakerCradleRing
cradle_ring.important: Cut cavity from cradle separately before fusing ring into lid; do not subtract cavity from existing lid.

lead_relief.name: SpeakerLeadRelief
lead_relief.note: 3mm wide opening in cradle right wall. Right screw boss shifted to Y42 to clear exit at X62,Y47.

retainer.name: SpeakerRetainer
retainer.operation: Filleted blank minus window, screw holes, two hex nut pockets. Nuts insert from underside; 0.8mm pocket roof remains.

front_gasket.note: 0.6mm allowance, material only on verified speaker frame; exact rim is unmeasured.

back_pad.note: 0.5mm allowance, avoid terminals and unsupported diaphragm; select shims by physical fit.

hardware.screw: 2 x M2 x 12mm pan/button head, optional 0.3mm flat washer included in reference stack
hardware.nut: 2 x M2 hex, ISO4032/DIN934 nominal4.0mmAF x1.6mm
hardware.lid_top_at_screws: 24.6 mm exact local section (underside21.0; wall3.6). Washer24.6..24.9; M2x12 shaft12.9..24.9.

integration.lid: Fuse SpeakerCradleRing and both R4.0 bosses, then cut SpeakerCradleCavity from this complete mountstructure to trim bossinneredges. Fuse this cleared frame into healed R5lid; then cut screw holes,grille,lead relief. Never cut cradle cavity from original lidroof.
integration.base: Healed R5 base only; no new speaker feature.

limits: Nominal consumer listing dimensions are approximate.
Retainer and cradle support the speaker casing/frame only; do not load central diaphragm.
Boss hard stops fix retainer plane atZ16.4; adjust foam/shims instead of tightening to crush the body.
Direct wires go to amplifier SPK+/SPK-, never systemGND; terminal left/right polarity must be read from actual markings.
